assessment: The sealed package passes this independent preparation review. The round3 entry preserves the round1 validator, validates the actual round2 receipt schema, binds the ordered two-round cumulative registration and rejects invalid prerequisites or authority before backend construction. Candidate sources, dependencies, SDK files and inherited runtime modules match their recorded hashes. Saved offline evidence supports the implementation; this verdict grants no actual execution, result-review allocation or acceptance credit.

strengths.assessment: The validators preserve both actual execution schemas: round1 work_cli_launches/automatic_retry_recorded and round2 work_cli_count with authority retry_authorized and limits.actual_reruns_or_retries. Both require the current candidate, runtime manifest, model/digest, eight PASS verdicts and terminal/review hash relationships.

Round2 eligibility binds round1 registration and review credentials, exactly two ordered cumulative entries, distinct review task IDs, increasing terminal completion timestamps, and each entry's candidate, terminal/review hashes, task ID and completion time.

Sealed dependencies and both prerequisite semantics are checked before backend construction. Authority must match the exact ordered predecessor list and round3 scope. Previously consumed actual-case directories remain rejected, with exclusive creation retained.

The added suite includes an allowed synthetic round3 path and semantic, seal, chain and authority rejection cases. Mutation helpers repair hashes where appropriate so semantic failures are not merely stale-hash failures; rejection tests assert no backend construction and no actual directory.

Minor.issue: The same-task and backwards-time variants alter only cumulative registration rows. They test row-to-credential mismatch, but do not directly exercise the distinct-task and chronological-order guards with coherently rebound review/terminal credentials.
Minor.impact: The implementation contains both guards and rejects these inputs; this is a diagnostic coverage limitation rather than an observed admission defect.
Minor.recommendation: In a future authorized test update, add coherent duplicate-task and reversed-terminal-time fixtures with all dependent hashes and cumulative rows updated, plus a missing cumulative-row variant.

review_focus.basis: Read the original-format execution fields in both copied reviews and the synthetic fixture builder. Six original/copy pairs are byte-identical; neither prior review was normalized or rewritten.

Current candidate/case, terminal state, independent verdicts, runtime/model bindings and receipt hashes are required before native construction. New tests cover second-round ineligibility, omitted sealed dependencies and malformed chain bindings.

The saved round2 registration actually binds the two distinct terminal/review pairs, ordered cases and task IDs, and round1 registration hash. The validator requires exactly two entries and verifies their relationships rather than trusting aggregate PASS counts.

Exact list equality rejects omitted, reversed, duplicated and incorrect second-round authority bindings. Old scope and consumed-case rejection remain present, as do admission/proof freshness and backend timing checks.

Documentation and terminal construction keep actual facts pending and acceptance_credit false. The package currently has no release or actual directory. Fake-native tests and Python I/O interception are not represented as live round3 proof.
